transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess what finally pushed me to come in is just... my eating has been kind of all over the place lately. Some weeks I barely touch dinner. And then... I don't know, other nights I just end up standing in the kitchen eating crackers and sweets after everyone else has gone to bed.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
When you eat like that at night, do you feel like you eat an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?
Um... no, I don't think so. It's not... a huge amount or anything. Just snacking, really.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?

No... not really. Like I said earlier, my eating is just sort of up and down right now. Since I have those weeks where I barely eat, but then other times I'm snacking on all those sweets at night... I guess it just balances out. My weight hasn't really changed much.
Do your eating habits cause you a lot of distress?
No... not really. I don't... it doesn't really bother me. It's just how I eat, I guess.
Are you strongly afraid of gaining weight or becoming fat?
No... I don't really think about it. It's not something I worry about.
Do you ever intentionally skip meals or severely restrict what you eat?
No... not on purpose. I mean, sometimes I skip them, but just because... I just don't feel like eating. I'm not trying to restrict anything.
When you eat at night, do you feel like you can’t stop once you start?
No... not really. I just eat a little bit and then I stop. It's not like I can't control it.
When you have those nighttime eating episodes, do you ever eat an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?
No... not really. Just a normal amount, I guess. I don't eat that much.
